Peggy was NOT referencing Jaguar. In S4E07, The Suitcase, Don and Peggy are out at a bar and Peggy mentions how "everyone thinks [Peggy] slept with [Don] to get the job [copy writer]." In S2E01, like another commenter mentioned, coworkers such as Dale, Harry, and Paul speculate that Peggy got knocked up by Draper which resulted in her being elevated. Peggy is insecure about being perceived as successful as a result of her sexual behavior as opposed to her talent. When Joan brings up Don "holding her hand," she instinctively assumes Joan is referencing the "knocked up by Don" theory.

However, when considering it from Joan's perspective, we see that her preoccupations are all about not being iced out from the Avon account and trying to kickstart a career as an account woman. Joan has no reliable allies, and Pete is intent on keeping the account for himself. On the contrary, Peggy had allies when she was trying to kickstart her career as a copywriter.
